verdicts.reason: Both reflow the headline into four lines with the CTA centred beneath, and keep the font, colours and hierarchy, so they are nearly the same. A sits low on the canvas: there is about 170px of space above the headline but only about 50px below the CTA, and the headline-to-CTA gap is tight. B centres the block better and gives the CTA more room. In both, the 'Bubbles,' line is short and the whitespace above and below the block is a little generous.
